summary.text: Become Dragon Mound is a Northern Plains resource point dense with transformation path dao marks that once produced many dragon Gu.

claims.text: Become Dragon Mound holds many transformation path dao marks. Those dao marks let living beings staying there transform into dragon beasts. Large numbers of related dragon Gu once formed there, including golden dragon Gu, water dragon Gu, earth dragon Gu, dragon claw Gu, dragon breath Gu, and dragon pearl Gu. The mound itself is short and flat and does not look like much. After Hei tribe was destroyed several Gu Immortals ransacked the site, and whatever Hei tribe’s fourth supreme elder had developed there was later carried off by the Bai Zu tribe Gu Immortals who took over.

In the months before Fang Yuan arrives, Bai Zu tribe takes control, guards the mound, and allocates resources to rebuild it toward its former state. It becomes one of Bai Zu tribe’s important resource points. Hei tribe’s fourth supreme elder originally guarded it at rank seven, but Bai Zu tribe later stations only a rank six Gu Immortal there.

Outside Become Dragon Mound, Chu Sect strength path Gu Immortals plan the strike while Fang Yuan flies up and calls for Bai Zu tribe to come out, saying Chu Sect is taking over Become Dragon Mound. A young Bai Zu Gu Immortal answers in rage, then activates the mound’s defensive Gu formation so bright light envelops the whole site. Fang Yuan crushes that formation in under five breaths. The rank six Bai Zu immortal flees. Landscape as Before Immortal Gu would repair the ruin, but Fang Yuan cannot use it while others watch, so he pulls up the ruined mound with Pulling Mountain Immortal Gu instead and stuffs it into his immortal aperture. Bai Zu tribe later finds the area turned into a giant pit, its biggest loss among the attacked resource points, while Heavenly Lord Bai Zu still refuses to abandon the Hei Fan grotto-heaven siege. After the taking, Mini Southern Border gains another named mountain, and Become Dragon Mound’s deep foundations make it the second most valuable mountain there after Five Light Mountain, ahead of Immortal Succession Mountain.
